There is a variant of Definition <REF_0001>
where we consider only those morphism <MATH_0001> defined on
scheme theoretically dense open subschemes <MATH_0002>.
We use Lemma <REF_0002>
to see that we obtain an equivalence relation.
An equivalence class of these is called a
<TEXTITOPEN_0001>pseudo-morphism from <MATH_0003> to <MATH_0004><TEXTITCLOSE_0001>.
If <MATH_0005> is reduced the two notions coincide.
